title: Last Bell, 2017
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The bell, three months before Twenty Years. Wood at the school for the first time since 1999 — outside it. The napkin kid is on the steps.

panels.composition: Small Wood High, 3:05 PM, the bell. WOOD across the road on foot with BARNABY II — the Legacy's in the shop. On the steps: a kid drawing on a napkin. Wood sees him.

characters.pose: on the steps, drawing on a napkin

image.prompt: a small-town high school at the last bell seen from across the road, a man and a three-legged dog on the far sidewalk, a teenager on the steps drawing on a napkin, clean ink

panels.composition: The kid, drawing. Not looking up. The way Gully didn't in 1997.

image.prompt: close-up of a teenager on school steps drawing intently on a napkin, not looking up

panels.composition: Wood, not crossing. The pup pulling toward the kid. Wood holding him.

image.prompt: a man holding back a three-legged dog that wants to cross the road toward a teenager on some steps, no words

panels.composition: The kid getting up, napkin in his pocket, walking toward the beach with the others. Wood watching him go. The pad in Wood's coat, untouched.

image.prompt: a teenager walking away toward a beach with a napkin in his pocket among other students, a man with a dog watching from across the road, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: The napkin kid, first sighting. In September Wood will sit at his table.
